Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 27, 2026 · Singapore Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) Compliance

Zero Data Resale Guarantee: eightysix dining never sells, rents, or shares your personal data with third-party advertisers or data brokers. Data collected is strictly used for dining reservations, allergen safety, and private host communications.

1. Data We Collect

When you reserve or inquire about a dining experience, we collect:

  • Full Name and WhatsApp / Phone Number for guest verification and gate access.
  • Dietary requirements, food allergies, and taste preferences.
  • Transaction reference IDs (PayNow / Stripe receipt confirmation).

2. Purpose of Collection

Your data is processed strictly for:

  • Confirming seat availability for The Suka-Suka Session.
  • Customizing allergen-safe pastry courses for your session.
  • Issuing automated secret lab address and gate entry pass upon deposit confirmation.
